propositions: Multiple token-identical definitions of _shadow exist across _mcp_llm.py, _mcp_reads.py, _mcp_writes.py, and _lib_ops.py that should be consolidated into a single canonical helper.
Three identical argparse _positive_int converters exist in request.py, bridge.py, and reconcile.py that should be unified into one shared implementation.
_ticket_id appears as AST-identical code in steps.py and decide_ops.py and should be consolidated into a single definition.
Exactly one definition of each helper (_shadow, _positive_int, _ticket_id) must remain under src/rebar after consolidation, with all callsites routed through the single canonical location.
All four _shadow callsites including the _lib_ops variant that forwards repo_root=None must route through the consolidated helper without altering observable behavior.
The out-of-scope namesake _config_resolvers._positive_int with different semantics (returns default vs raises error) must remain unchanged and not be merged with the argparse converter.
